title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: The highly anticipated Spyglass tool has officially launched, providing all users with powerful new capabilities to enhance their workflow and insights.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Enjoy unparalleled control over your documents and images directly within the editor, with new tools for easy upload, download, and customizable display options.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Discover our brand new public roadmap, providing a transparent look at recently completed features, upcoming updates, and future plans.

title: Intuitive Checkboxes, Beautifully Redesigned
summary: Our beautifully redesigned checkboxes are now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, offering a seamless and intuitive way to manage your tasks.

title: Seamless Collaborative Editing
summary: Collaborate with unparalleled ease and clarity as we enhance our editor's real-time features, making teamwork more intuitive and efficient.

title: Unlock Shared Discoveries
summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with enhanced visibility and search capabilities.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: We're thrilled to bring Noeko to a global audience by adding comprehensive support for numerous international languages.

title: A New Era: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement, and unparalleled transparency in the project's evolution.

title: Empower Your Knowledge Exploration with the Advanced Graph View
summary: We're enhancing the graph view with powerful filtering capabilities and workflow integrations, allowing you to easily discover and organize your knowledge like never before.

title: Enhanced Search Filters & Saved Compendiums
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and curate your most relevant information by applying advanced filters, comprehensive sorting options, and saving your tailored search results as personalized Compendiums.

title: Dynamic Content Integration
summary: Unlock more intuitive ways to organize and view your connected ideas with enhanced visual layouts and interactive content previews.

title: Noeko: Your Platform, Your Way with Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: Soon, you'll be able to host Noeko on your own infrastructure, empowering teams with greater control and access to advanced features through our new flexible plans.

title: Stunning New Themes and Refined Classics
summary: Prepare for a vibrant new look as we refine existing themes and introduce a captivating array of fresh styles to customize your Noeko workspace.

title: Personalized Time of Day Welcome
summary: Get a more accurate and delightful welcome with greetings that perfectly match the current time of day wherever you are.

title: Quick Actions for Tagged Items
summary: Perform key actions like unapplying tags, deleting items, and viewing details directly from your tag lists with new, powerful controls, saving you significant time and effort.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Effortlessly integrate and interact with a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your knowledge base like never before.
